acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.acceptance_metrics: duration-weighted speaker accuracy, DER family, FP speaker-seconds, per-case regressions, two-sided mapping, determinism, and compute budget under the campaign gates
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.corpus: multiple meetings with both local-mic and remote-system lanes, varied speakers, genders, acoustics, crosstalk, overlap, and genuine same-speaker-across-lanes cases
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.human_audit: speaker and activity references audited for identity, timing, overlap, and crosstalk; no one-person-per-lane assumption
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.instrument: D8-safe production runtime segmentation, full-chain golden-path audit, label-perturbation invariance, and same-frame L1/F2 comparison
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.source_integrity: immutable synchronized audio and runtime lane metadata with captured missing-lane and wrong-lane controls
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.splits: preregistered development, validation, and single-open blind holdout containing long meetings and similar-voice hard cases

interpretation: measured acoustic lane-prior effect only; no speaker identity or acceptance claim
